customManagers.description: Tool versions in workflows, marked with a '# renovate:' comment on the line above
Versions in Ansible variables, marked with a '# renovate:' comment on the line above (e.g. immich_version)

packageRules.description: linuxserver.io tags look like 4.0.20.3014-ls5 / v1.6.2-ls372: app version plus image build number
linuxserver restarted sonarr's build numbers at ls1, so the older ls3xx builds of 4.0.20.3014 look 'newer'. Remove after sonarr 4.0.21
qBittorrent is version-locked on purpose: no update PRs. Change the tag by hand when ready
Database major versions need a dump/restore or pg_upgrade, never an image bump
Immich's compose file (Postgres + Valkey pinned by digest) is updated from upstream by hand, together with a version bump, never by Renovate
Immich: one reviewed PR per release, never auto-merged. Merging deploys it via Ansible
prBodyNotes: **Before merging:** read the [Immich release notes](https://github.com/immich-app/immich/releases) for breaking changes. If they say to update `docker-compose.yml`, replace the upstream part of `stacks/little-skynet/immich/compose.yaml` in this same PR.
**Merging deploys immediately:** the `ansible` workflow dumps the database, updates the VM and waits for Immich to report healthy.

packageRules.description: Immich major releases (v4, v5...) only get a PR once they're 7 days old, so the first patch fixes are usually out by then

Portainer: the server and every agent share one version (ansible/inventory/group_vars/portainer_hosts.yml). Only patch releases of the current LTS line (2.45), always reviewed. To move to a newer LTS, change allowedVersions here and the version there together
prBodyNotes: **One version for the server and all agents.** Read the [Portainer release notes](https://github.com/portainer/portainer/releases) first.

**Merging does not deploy by itself (yet).** After merging, run the `portainer` playbook from the Actions tab: it backs up the server's data, upgrades the server, then the agents, and checks every environment.

packageRules.description: One PR for the whole *arr stack, so it redeploys once
Low-risk stacks: minor/patch updates merge automatically once CI passes and the release is 3 days old
CI tooling (workflow actions, docker compose, Renovate itself) auto-merges on minor/patch
